name: A360 Insights
author: Igor Rubas / A360

sections.description:
A360 Insights is a lightweight, privacy-first analytics plugin for WordPress.

Track content performance directly inside your WordPress dashboard without relying on external analytics tools, cookies, or personal data collection.

Perfect for bloggers, marketers, agencies and website owners who want simple analytics that respect privacy.

Features

  • Page and post view tracking
  • Custom post type support
  • Real-time content statistics modal
  • Traffic source detection
  • Referrer analytics
  • UTM campaign tracking
  • Traffic channel breakdown
  • Dashboard summary widget
  • CSV export
  • Bot filtering
  • Ignore logged-in users
  • Ignore administrators
  • Browser prefetch filtering
  • WP-CLI and cron filtering
  • Data retention controls
  • Delete all data on uninstall
  • Privacy-friendly architecture
  • No cookies
  • No IP address storage
  • No user-agent storage
  • GDPR-friendly approach

Ideal for

  • Content publishers
  • SEO specialists
  • Marketing agencies
  • Landing page tracking
  • Campaign measurement
  • Privacy-conscious websites
  • Lightweight analytics alternative

Privacy

A360 Insights does NOT store:

  • IP addresses
  • Cookies
  • User IDs
  • Personal identifiers
  • User-agent strings

Optional tracking data:

  • Referrer host / URL
  • UTM parameters
  • Anonymous event timestamps

All analytics remain inside your own WordPress installation.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/a360-insights/
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen
  3. Go to Settings → A360 Insights
  4. Choose what content should be tracked
  5. Open Posts / Pages and click the Views counter
sections.faq:
Does this use cookies?

No. A360 Insights does not use cookies.

Does this track IP addresses?

No. IP addresses are never stored.

Is it GDPR compliant?

The plugin is designed with privacy-first principles and avoids storing personal identifiers.
Website owners remain responsible for their own legal compliance.

Can I track UTM campaigns?

Yes. UTM source, medium and campaign parameters can be tracked.

Can I export analytics?

Yes. CSV export is included.

Does it support custom post types?

Yes.

Can I exclude administrators?

Yes.
